sentences.zh: __FORCETOC__皇后歲祀一，季春吉巳享先蠶，遂以親桑。

translations.literal: __FORCETOC__The empress's annual sacrifice once: in late spring on an auspicious ji day she sacrifices to the Silkworm Ancestor, then personally tends the mulberry.
translations.idiomatic: __FORCETOC__The empress's annual sacrifice: in late spring on an auspicious ji day she offers to the Silkworm Ancestor, then personally picks mulberry leaves.

sentences.zh: 散齋三日於後殿；

translations.literal: She observes dispersed abstinence three days in the rear hall;
translations.idiomatic: She keeps dispersed abstinence for three days in the rear hall;

sentences.zh: 致齋一日於正寢，一日於正殿。

translations.literal: concentrated abstinence one day in the principal sleeping quarters, one day in the principal hall.
translations.idiomatic: then concentrated abstinence one day in the principal quarters and one day in the principal hall.

sentences.zh: 前一日，尚舍設御幄於正殿西序及室中，俱東向。

translations.literal: On the day before, the Palace Provisioners set the imperial canopy in the west wing of the principal hall and in the inner chamber, all facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The day before, the Palace Provisioners set the imperial canopy in the west wing of the principal hall and in the inner chamber, all facing east.

sentences.zh: 致齋之日，晝漏上水一刻，尚儀版奏「請中嚴」。

translations.literal: On the day of concentrated abstinence, when the day clepsydra reached the first quarter-mark after filling, the Director of Ceremonies reported on the board, "Request inner vigil."
translations.idiomatic: On the abstinence day, when the day clepsydra reached the first quarter-mark after filling, the Director of Ceremonies reported, "Request inner vigil."

sentences.zh: 尚服帥司仗布侍衞，司賓引內命婦陪位。

translations.literal: The Director of Wardrobe led the ushers to array attendants; the Receptionist led inner titled ladies to attend in place.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Wardrobe arrayed attendants; the Receptionist led inner titled ladies to their places.

sentences.zh: 六尚以下，各服其服，詣後殿奉迎。

translations.literal: The Six Directors and below, each in proper dress, went to the rear hall to welcome her.
translations.idiomatic: The Six Directors and below, each in proper dress, went to the rear hall to welcome her.

sentences.zh: 尚儀版奏「外辦」。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies reported on the board, "Outer preparations complete."
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies reported, "Outer preparations complete."

sentences.zh: 上水二刻，皇后服鈿釵禮衣，結珮，乘輿出自西房，華蓋警蹕。

translations.literal: At the second quarter-mark after filling, the empress wore the hairpin-and-pendant ceremonial robe, tied her girdle pendants, and rode the palanquin out from the west chamber, with canopy and road clearance.
translations.idiomatic: At the second quarter-mark, the empress wore ceremonial robes with hairpins and pendants, tied her girdle ornaments, and rode out from the west chamber under canopy with road clearance.

sentences.zh: 皇后即御座，六尚以下侍衞。

translations.literal: The empress took the imperial seat; the Six Directors and below attended.
translations.idiomatic: The empress took her seat; the Six Directors and below stood attendance.

sentences.zh: 一刻頃，尚儀前跪奏稱：「尚儀妾姓言，請降就齋室。

translations.literal: After about one quarter-mark, the Director of Ceremonies knelt forward and reported: "Your servant, the Director of Ceremonies, surname [X], reports: please descend to the abstinence chamber.
translations.idiomatic: After about one quarter-mark, the Director of Ceremonies knelt and reported: "Your servant, the Director of Ceremonies, reports: please descend to the abstinence chamber.

sentences.zh: 」皇后降座，乘輿入室。

translations.literal: " The empress descended from the seat and rode the palanquin into the chamber.
translations.idiomatic: " The empress left her seat and rode the palanquin into the chamber.

sentences.zh: 散齋之日，內侍帥內命婦之吉者，使蠶於蠶室，諸預享者皆齋。

translations.literal: On the day of dispersed abstinence, the inner attendants led auspicious inner titled ladies to raise silkworms in the silkworm chamber; all who would take part in the sacrifice kept abstinence.
translations.idiomatic: On dispersed-abstinence day, inner attendants led auspicious inner titled ladies to raise silkworms in the silkworm chamber; all participants kept abstinence.

sentences.zh: 前享三日，尚舍直長設大次於外壝東門之內道北，南向；

translations.literal: Three days before the sacrifice, the chief provisioner of the Palace Provisioners set the great tent north of the path inside the outer enclosure's east gate, facing south;
translations.idiomatic: Three days before the sacrifice, the chief provisioner set the great tent north of the path inside the outer enclosure's east gate, facing south;

sentences.zh: 內命婦及六尚以下次於其後，俱南向。

translations.literal: inner titled ladies and the Six Directors and below were tented behind them, all facing south.
translations.idiomatic: inner titled ladies and the Six Directors and below were placed behind them, all facing south.

sentences.zh: 守宮設外命婦次，大長公主、長公主、公主以下於南壝之外道西，三公夫人以下在其南，重行異位，東向北上。

translations.literal: The Palace Keeper set tents for outer titled ladies: grand-eldest princesses, eldest princesses, and princesses and below west of the path outside the south enclosure; wives of the Three Excellencies and below south of them, in double ranks at separate places, facing east and advancing northward.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Keeper set tents for outer titled ladies: grand-eldest and eldest princesses and princesses west of the path outside the south enclosure; wives of the Three Excellencies south of them, in staggered double ranks facing east.

sentences.zh: 陳饌幔於內壝東門之外道南，北向。

translations.literal: Offerings were draped south of the path outside the inner enclosure's east gate, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: Offering curtains were set south of the path outside the inner enclosure's east gate, facing north.

sentences.zh: 前享二日，太樂令設宮縣之樂於壇南內壝之內，諸女工各位於縣後。

translations.literal: Two days before the sacrifice, the Director of Music set palace suspended music inside the inner enclosure south of the altar; all female musicians took their places behind the bells.
translations.idiomatic: Two days before the sacrifice, the Director of Music set palace suspended music inside the inner enclosure south of the altar; female musicians stood behind the bells.

sentences.zh: 右校為采桑壇於壇南二十步所，方三丈，高五尺，四出陛。

translations.literal: The Right Works built a mulberry-picking altar twenty paces south of the altar, three zhang square, five chi high, with steps on four sides.
translations.idiomatic: The Right Works built a mulberry-picking altar twenty paces south of the main altar, three zhang square and five chi high, with steps on four sides.

sentences.zh: 尚舍量施帷障於外壝之外，四面開門，其東門足容厭翟車。

translations.literal: The Palace Provisioners measured and hung screens outside the outer enclosure, with gates on four sides; the east gate was wide enough for the Yan-Di carriage.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Provisioners hung screens outside the outer enclosure with gates on four sides; the east gate was wide enough for the Yan-Di carriage.

sentences.zh: 前享一日，內謁者設御位於壇之東南，西向；

translations.literal: One day before the sacrifice, the inner ushers set the imperial place southeast of the altar, facing west;
translations.idiomatic: One day before the sacrifice, inner ushers set the imperial place southeast of the altar, facing west;

sentences.zh: 望瘞位於西南，當瘞埳，西向。

translations.literal: the distant-burial place at the southwest, aligned with the burial pit, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: the distant-burial place at the southwest, aligned with the burial pit, facing west.

sentences.zh: 亞獻、終獻位於內壝東門之內道南，執事者位於其後，重行異位，西向北上。

translations.literal: secondary and final offering places south of the path inside the inner enclosure's east gate; attendants behind them in double ranks at separate places, facing west and advancing northward.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary and final offering places south of the path inside the inner enclosure's east gate; attendants behind them in staggered ranks facing west.

sentences.zh: 典正位於壇下，一位於東南，西向；

translations.literal: Directors of Protocol below the altar: one place at the southeast, facing west;
translations.idiomatic: Directors of Protocol below the altar: one at the southeast facing west;

sentences.zh: 一位於西南，東向。

translations.literal: one place at the southwest, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: one at the southwest facing east.

sentences.zh: 女史各陪其後。

translations.literal: female scribes each attended behind them.
translations.idiomatic: Female scribes stood behind each.

sentences.zh: 司贊位於樂縣東北，掌贊二人在南，差退，西面。

translations.literal: the Director of Praise northeast of the music stand, two Praise Attendants south of him, stepped back, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Praise stood northeast of the music stand; two Praise Attendants south of him, stepped back, facing west.

sentences.zh: 又設司贊、掌贊位於埋埳西南，東面南上；

translations.literal: Director of Praise and Praise Attendants were also set southwest of the burial pit, facing east and advancing southward;
translations.idiomatic: Director of Praise and Praise Attendants were also set southwest of the burial pit, facing east;

sentences.zh: 典樂舉麾位於壇上南陛之西，東向；

translations.literal: the Director of Music who raises the baton west of the south steps on the altar, facing east;
translations.idiomatic: the Director of Music who raises the baton west of the south steps on the altar, facing east;

sentences.zh: 司樂位於北縣之間，當壇北向。

translations.literal: the Director of Music between the northern bells, facing the altar northward.
translations.idiomatic: the Director of Music between the northern bells, facing the altar northward.

sentences.zh: 內命婦位於終獻之南，絕位，重行異位，西向北上；

translations.literal: inner titled ladies south of the final offering, in separate places, double ranks at separate stations, facing west and advancing northward;
translations.idiomatic: Inner titled ladies south of the final offering, in separate staggered ranks facing west;

sentences.zh: 外命婦位於中壝南門之外，大長公主以下於道東，西向，當內命婦，差退；

translations.literal: outer titled ladies outside the middle enclosure's south gate: grand-eldest princesses and below east of the path, facing west, aligned with inner titled ladies, stepped back;
translations.idiomatic: outer titled ladies outside the middle enclosure's south gate: grand-eldest princesses and below east of the path, facing west, aligned with inner titled ladies;

sentences.zh: 太夫人以下於道西，去道遠近如公主，重行異位，相向北上。

translations.literal: grand madames and below west of the path, distance from the path like the princesses', double ranks at separate places, facing each other and advancing northward.
translations.idiomatic: grand madames and below west of the path at the same distance as the princesses, in staggered ranks facing each other.

sentences.zh: 又設御采桑位於壇上，東向；

translations.literal: the imperial mulberry-picking place was also set on the altar, facing east;
translations.idiomatic: The imperial mulberry-picking place was also set on the altar, facing east;

sentences.zh: 內命婦采桑位於壇下，當御位東南，北向西上；

translations.literal: inner titled ladies' mulberry places below the altar, southeast of the imperial place, facing north and advancing westward;
translations.idiomatic: inner titled ladies' mulberry places below the altar, southeast of the imperial place, facing north;

sentences.zh: 執御鉤、筐者位於內命婦之西少南，西上；

translations.literal: those holding imperial hooks and baskets slightly south and west of the inner titled ladies, advancing westward;
translations.idiomatic: those holding imperial hooks and baskets slightly south and west of the inner titled ladies;

sentences.zh: 內外命婦執鉤、筐者位各於其采桑位之後。

translations.literal: inner and outer titled ladies holding hooks and baskets each behind their mulberry places.
translations.idiomatic: inner and outer titled ladies with hooks and baskets stood behind their mulberry places.

sentences.zh: 設門外位：享官於東壝之外道南，從享內命婦於享官之東，北面西上；

translations.literal: Outer places were set: sacrifice officers south of the path outside the east enclosure; inner titled ladies joining the sacrifice east of the officers, facing north and advancing westward;
translations.idiomatic: Outer places were set: sacrifice officers south of the path outside the east enclosure; inner titled ladies joining the sacrifice east of them, facing north;

sentences.zh: 從享外命婦於南壝之外道西，如設次。

translations.literal: outer titled ladies joining the sacrifice west of the path outside the south enclosure, as when tents were set.
translations.idiomatic: outer titled ladies joining the sacrifice west of the path outside the south enclosure, as for the tents.

sentences.zh: 設酒尊之位於壇上東南隅，北向西上；

translations.literal: wine-vessel places at the southeast corner of the altar, facing north and advancing westward;
translations.idiomatic: Wine vessels at the southeast corner of the altar, facing north;

sentences.zh: 御洗於壇南陛東南，亞獻之洗又於東南，俱北向；

translations.literal: imperial washing southeast of the south steps, secondary offering washing again at the southeast, all facing north;
translations.idiomatic: imperial washing southeast of the south steps, secondary-offering washing again at the southeast, all facing north;

sentences.zh: 幣篚於壇上尊坫之所。

translations.literal: silk baskets at the altar mound beside the honored vessels.
translations.idiomatic: silk baskets at the altar mound beside the honored vessels.

sentences.zh: 晡後，內謁者帥其屬以尊坫、罍洗、篚冪入，設於位。

translations.literal: After mid-afternoon, inner ushers led their subordinates in with altar mounds, urn-washing stands, basket covers, and set them at the places.
translations.idiomatic: After mid-afternoon, inner ushers brought altar mounds, urn-washing stands, and basket covers and set them in place.

sentences.zh: 升壇者自東陛。

translations.literal: Those ascending the altar used the east steps.
translations.idiomatic: Those ascending the altar used the east steps.

sentences.zh: 享日，未明十五刻，太官令帥宰人以鸞刀割牲，祝史以豆取毛血置於饌所，遂烹牲。

translations.literal: On the sacrifice day, at the fifteenth quarter-mark before dawn, the Director of the Palace Kitchens led butchers to cut the victim with the phoenix knife; the invoker took hair and blood in a dou and placed them at the offering site, then the victim was cooked.
translations.idiomatic: On sacrifice day, at the fifteenth quarter-mark before dawn, the Director of the Palace Kitchens led butchers to cut the victim with the phoenix knife; the invoker took hair and blood in a dou for the offering site, then the victim was cooked.

sentences.zh: 五刻，司設升，設先蠶氏神座於壇上北方，南向。

translations.literal: At the fifth quarter-mark, the Director of Setup ascended and set the Silkworm Ancestor spirit seat on the north of the altar, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: At the fifth quarter-mark, the Director of Setup set the Silkworm Ancestor spirit seat on the north of the altar, facing south.

sentences.zh: 前享一日，金吾奏：「請外命婦等應集壇所者聽夜行，其應采桑者四人，各有女侍者進筐、鉤載之而行。

translations.literal: One day before the sacrifice, the Gold Crow reported: "Outer titled ladies and others who should gather at the altar may travel at night; the four who will pick mulberry each have female attendants bring baskets and hooks loaded as they go.
translations.idiomatic: One day before the sacrifice, the Gold Crow reported: "Outer titled ladies gathering at the altar may travel at night; the four mulberry-pickers each have female attendants carry baskets and hooks.

sentences.zh: 」其日未明四刻，搥一鼓為一嚴；

translations.literal: " On that day, at the fourth quarter-mark before dawn, one drum-strike made the first vigil;
translations.idiomatic: " That day, at the fourth quarter-mark before dawn, one drum-strike signaled the first vigil;

sentences.zh: 二刻，搥二鼓為再嚴。

translations.literal: at the second quarter-mark, two drum-strikes made the second vigil.
translations.idiomatic: at the second quarter-mark, two drum-strikes signaled the second vigil.

sentences.zh: 尚儀版奏「請中嚴」。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies reported on the board, "Request inner vigil."
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies reported, "Request inner vigil."

sentences.zh: 一刻，搥三鼓為三嚴。

translations.literal: At the first quarter-mark, three drum-strikes made the third vigil.
translations.idiomatic: At the first quarter-mark, three drum-strikes signaled the third vigil.

sentences.zh: 司賓引內命婦入，立於庭，重行，西面北上。

translations.literal: The Receptionist led inner titled ladies in and had them stand in the court in double ranks, facing west and advancing northward.
translations.idiomatic: The Receptionist led inner titled ladies into the court in double ranks, facing west.

sentences.zh: 六尚以下詣室奉迎。

translations.literal: The Six Directors and below went to the chamber to welcome her.
translations.idiomatic: The Six Directors and below went to the chamber to welcome her.

sentences.zh: 尚服負寶，內僕進厭翟車於閤外，尚儀版奏「外辦」。

translations.literal: The Director of Wardrobe bore the imperial seal; inner servants brought the Yan-Di carriage outside the gate; the Director of Ceremonies reported, "Outer preparations complete."
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Wardrobe bore the imperial seal; inner servants brought the Yan-Di carriage outside the gate; the Director of Ceremonies reported, "Outer preparations complete."

sentences.zh: 馭者執轡，皇后服鞠衣，乘輿以出，華蓋、侍衞、警蹕。

translations.literal: Drivers held the reins; the empress wore the ju ceremonial robe and rode the palanquin out, with canopy, attendants, and road clearance.
translations.idiomatic: Drivers held the reins; the empress wore the ju robe and rode out under canopy with attendants and road clearance.

sentences.zh: 內命婦從出門。

translations.literal: Inner titled ladies followed out the gate.
translations.idiomatic: Inner titled ladies followed out the gate.

sentences.zh: 皇后升車，尚功進鉤，司製進筐，載之。

translations.literal: The empress mounted the carriage; the Director of Works presented the hook, the Director of Manufacture presented the basket, and they were loaded.
translations.idiomatic: The empress mounted the carriage; the Director of Works presented the hook and the Director of Manufacture the basket, and they were loaded.

sentences.zh: 內命婦及六尚等乘車從，諸翊駕之官皆乘馬。

translations.literal: Inner titled ladies and the Six Directors and others followed in carriages; all escort officials rode horses.
translations.idiomatic: Inner titled ladies and the Six Directors followed in carriages; all escort officials rode horses.

sentences.zh: 駕動，警蹕，不鳴鼓角。

translations.literal: When the train moved, road clearance was observed but drums and horns were not sounded.
translations.idiomatic: When the train moved, road clearance was observed but drums and horns were not sounded.

sentences.zh: 內命婦、宮人以次從。

translations.literal: Inner titled ladies and palace women followed in order.
translations.idiomatic: Inner titled ladies and palace women followed in order.

sentences.zh: 其日三刻，尚儀及司醞帥其屬入，實尊罍及幣，太官令實諸籩、豆、簠、簋、俎等，內謁者帥其屬詣廚奉饌入，設於饌幔內。

translations.literal: At the third quarter-mark that day, the Director of Ceremonies and the Director of Libations led their subordinates in to fill the honored urns and silks; the Director of the Palace Kitchens filled the trays, dou, square and round vessels, and stands; inner ushers led their subordinates from the kitchen with offerings into the offering curtain.
translations.idiomatic: At the third quarter-mark, the Director of Ceremonies and Director of Libations filled the honored urns and silks; the Director of the Palace Kitchens filled trays and vessels; inner ushers brought offerings into the offering curtain.

sentences.zh: 駕將至，女相者引享官，內典引引外命婦，俱就門外位。

translations.literal: As the train neared, female guides led sacrifice officers; inner guides led outer titled ladies; all took their outer places.
translations.idiomatic: As the train neared, female guides led sacrifice officers and inner guides led outer titled ladies to their outer places.

sentences.zh: 駕至大次門外，迴車南向，尚儀進車前跪奏稱：「尚儀妾姓言，請降車。

translations.literal: When the train reached outside the great tent gate, it turned the carriage south; the Director of Ceremonies advanced before the carriage, knelt, and reported: "Your servant, the Director of Ceremonies, surname [X], reports: please descend from the carriage.
translations.idiomatic: At the great tent gate the carriage turned south; the Director of Ceremonies knelt before it and reported: "Your servant, the Director of Ceremonies, reports: please descend from the carriage.

sentences.zh: 」皇后降車，乘輿之大次，華蓋、繖、扇。

translations.literal: " The empress descended; she rode the palanquin to the great tent, with canopy, parasol, and fans.
translations.idiomatic: " The empress descended and rode the palanquin to the great tent under canopy, parasol, and fans.

sentences.zh: 尚儀以祝版進，御署，出奠於坫。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies advanced the prayer board for imperial signature and placed it on the mound.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies brought the prayer board for imperial signature and placed it on the mound.

sentences.zh: 尚功、司製進受鉤、筐以退，典贊引亞獻及從享內命婦俱就門外位。

translations.literal: The Director of Works and Director of Manufacture advanced to receive the hook and basket and withdrew; the Director of Praise led the secondary offering and inner titled ladies joining the sacrifice to their outer places.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Works and Director of Manufacture received the hook and basket and withdrew; the Director of Praise led the secondary offering and participating inner titled ladies to their outer places.

sentences.zh: 司贊帥掌贊先入就位，女相者引尚儀、典正及女史、祝史與女執尊罍篚冪者入自東門，當壇南，北向西上。

translations.literal: The Director of Praise led Praise Attendants in first to take their places; female guides led the Director of Ceremonies, Directors of Protocol, female scribes, invokers, and women holding honored urns, baskets, and covers in through the east gate, south of the altar, facing north and advancing westward.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Praise led Praise Attendants in first; female guides led the Director of Ceremonies, Directors of Protocol, scribes, invokers, and women with urns and baskets in through the east gate south of the altar, facing north.

sentences.zh: 司贊曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The Director of Praise said: "Bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Praise said: "Bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」掌贊承傳，尚儀以下皆再拜，就位。

translations.literal: " Praise Attendants transmitted it; the Director of Ceremonies and below all bowed twice and took their places.
translations.idiomatic: " Praise Attendants relayed it; the Director of Ceremonies and below all bowed twice and took their places.

sentences.zh: 司樂帥女工人入，典贊引亞獻、終獻，女相者引執事者、司賓引內命婦、內典引引外命婦入，就位。

translations.literal: The Director of Music led female musicians in; the Director of Praise led secondary and final offerings; female guides led attendants; the Receptionist led inner titled ladies; inner guides led outer titled ladies in to take their places.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Music led female musicians in; the Director of Praise led secondary and final offerings; female guides led attendants; the Receptionist led inner titled ladies and inner guides led outer titled ladies to their places.

sentences.zh: 皇后停大次半刻頃，司言引尚宮立於大次門外，當門北向。

translations.literal: The empress paused at the great tent for about half a quarter-mark; the Director of Announcements led the Director of the Palace inward to stand outside the great tent gate, facing north at the gate.
translations.idiomatic: The empress paused at the great tent for about half a quarter-mark; the Director of Announcements led the Director of the Palace to stand outside the great tent gate, facing north.

sentences.zh: 尚儀版奏「外辦」。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies reported, "Outer preparations complete."
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies reported, "Outer preparations complete."

sentences.zh: 皇后出次，入自東門，至版位，西向立。

translations.literal: The empress left the tent, entered by the east gate, reached the marked place, and stood facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The empress left the tent, entered by the east gate, reached the marked place, and stood facing west.

sentences.zh: 尚宮曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The Director of the Palace said: "Bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Palace said: "Bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」皇后再拜。

translations.literal: " The empress bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: " The empress bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 司贊曰：「眾官再拜。

translations.idiomatic: " All present bowed twice.

translations.literal: The Director of the Palace said: "The officers have duly prepared; please proceed with the rite.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Palace said: "The officers have prepared; please proceed with the rite.

sentences.zh: 」樂三成。

translations.literal: " Music played three movements.
translations.idiomatic: " Music played three movements.

translations.literal: The Director of the Palace said: "Bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Palace said: "Bow twice.

translations.literal: " The empress bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: " The empress bowed twice.

translations.literal: The Director of Praise said: "All officers bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Praise said: "All officers bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」在位者皆再拜。

translations.literal: " All in place bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: " All present bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 壇上尚儀跪取幣於篚，興，立於尊所。

translations.literal: On the altar the Director of Ceremonies knelt, took silks from the basket, rose, and stood at the vessel place.
translations.idiomatic: On the altar the Director of Ceremonies knelt, took silks from the basket, rose, and stood at the vessel place.

sentences.zh: 皇后自壇南陛升，北面立，尚儀奉幣東向進，皇后受幣，進，北向，跪奠於神座，少退，再拜，降自南陛，復于位。

translations.literal: The empress ascended by the south steps, stood facing north; the Director of Ceremonies presented silks facing east; the empress received the silks, advanced, faced north, knelt and placed them on the spirit seat, withdrew slightly, bowed twice, descended by the south steps, and returned to her place.
translations.idiomatic: The empress ascended the south steps and stood facing north; the Director of Ceremonies presented silks from the east; the empress received them, advanced, knelt and placed them on the spirit seat, withdrew, bowed twice, descended the south steps, and returned to her place.

sentences.zh: 初，內外命婦拜訖，女祝史奉毛血之豆立於內壝東門之外，皇后已奠幣，乃奉毛血入，升自南陛，尚儀迎引於壇上，進，跪奠於神座前。

translations.literal: At first, after inner and outer titled ladies had bowed, the female invoker held the dou of hair and blood and stood outside the inner enclosure's east gate; after the empress had placed the silks, she then brought the hair and blood in, ascended by the south steps; the Director of Ceremonies welcomed and guided her onto the altar, advanced, knelt, and placed them before the spirit seat.
translations.idiomatic: After inner and outer titled ladies had bowed, the female invoker stood outside the inner east gate with the dou of hair and blood; once the empress had placed the silks, she brought them in by the south steps; the Director of Ceremonies guided her onto the altar to place them before the spirit seat.

sentences.zh: 皇后既升奠幣，司膳出，帥女進饌者奉饌陳於內壝東門之外。

translations.literal: After the empress had ascended and placed the silks, the Director of Viands went out and led women bearing offerings to array offerings outside the inner enclosure's east gate.
translations.idiomatic: After the empress had placed the silks, the Director of Viands led women bearing offerings to array them outside the inner east gate.

sentences.zh: 皇后既降，復位。

translations.literal: After the empress had descended, she returned to her place.
translations.idiomatic: After the empress descended, she returned to her place.

sentences.zh: 司膳引饌入，至階。

translations.literal: The Director of Viands led the offerings in to the steps.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Viands led the offerings in to the steps.

sentences.zh: 女祝史跪徹毛血之豆，降自東陛以出。

translations.literal: The female invoker knelt and removed the dou of hair and blood, descended by the east steps, and went out.
translations.idiomatic: The female invoker knelt, removed the dou of hair and blood, descended the east steps, and went out.

sentences.zh: 饌升自南陛，尚儀迎引於壇上，設於神座前。

translations.literal: The offerings ascended by the south steps; the Director of Ceremonies welcomed and guided them onto the altar and set them before the spirit seat.
translations.idiomatic: The offerings ascended the south steps; the Director of Ceremonies guided them onto the altar and set them before the spirit seat.

sentences.zh: 皇后詣罍洗，尚儀跪取匜，興，沃水；

translations.literal: The empress went to the urn washing-stand; the Director of Ceremonies knelt, took the pitcher, rose, and poured water;
translations.idiomatic: The empress went to the urn washing-stand; the Director of Ceremonies knelt, took the pitcher, rose, and poured water;

sentences.zh: 司言跪取盤，興，承水。

translations.literal: the Director of Announcements knelt, took the basin, rose, and received the water.
translations.idiomatic: the Director of Announcements knelt, took the basin, rose, and received the water.

sentences.zh: 皇后盥。

translations.literal: The empress washed her hands.
translations.idiomatic: The empress washed her hands.

sentences.zh: 司言跪取巾於篚，進以帨，受巾，跪奠於篚。

translations.literal: The Director of Announcements knelt, took the towel from the basket, advanced to offer it; she received the towel; he knelt and returned it to the basket.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Announcements knelt, took the towel from the basket and offered it; she received it; he knelt and returned it to the basket.

sentences.zh: 乃取爵於篚，興，進，受爵，尚儀酌罍水，司言奉盤，皇后洗爵，司言授巾，皆如初。

translations.literal: Then he took the goblet from the basket, rose, and advanced; she received the goblet; the Director of Ceremonies poured water from the urn; the Director of Announcements held the basin; the empress washed the goblet; the Director of Announcements gave the towel—all as before.
translations.idiomatic: Then he took the goblet from the basket and advanced; she received it; the Director of Ceremonies poured urn water; the Director of Announcements held the basin; the empress washed the goblet and received the towel as before.

sentences.zh: 皇后升自壇南陛，詣酒尊。

translations.literal: The empress ascended by the south steps of the altar and went to the wine vessel.
translations.idiomatic: The empress ascended the south steps and went to the wine vessel.

sentences.zh: 尚儀贊酌醴齊，進先蠶氏神座前，北向跪，奠爵，興，少退，立。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies praised the pouring of sacrificial ale, advanced before the Silkworm Ancestor spirit seat, knelt facing north, placed the goblet, rose, withdrew slightly, and stood.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies praised the pouring of sacrificial ale, advanced before the Silkworm Ancestor spirit seat, knelt facing north, placed the goblet, rose, withdrew, and stood.

sentences.zh: 尚儀持版進於神座之右，東面跪讀祝文。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies advanced the board to the right of the spirit seat and knelt facing east to read the prayer.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies advanced the board to the right of the spirit seat and knelt facing east to read the prayer.

sentences.zh: 皇后再拜，尚儀以爵酌上尊福酒，西向進，皇后再拜受爵，跪，祭酒，啐酒，奠爵，興。

translations.literal: The empress bowed twice; the Director of Ceremonies poured blessed wine from the goblet and advanced facing west; the empress bowed twice, received the goblet, knelt, offered a libation, sipped, placed the goblet, and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The empress bowed twice; the Director of Ceremonies poured blessed wine and advanced from the west; the empress bowed twice, received the goblet, knelt, offered a libation, sipped, placed the goblet, and rose.

sentences.zh: 尚儀帥女進饌者持籩、俎進神前，三牲胙肉各置一俎，又以籩取稷、黍飯共置一籩。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies led women bearing offerings with trays and stands to advance before the spirit; the three sacrificial meats' portions each on one stand, and millet and glutinous rice from a tray together on one tray.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies led women with trays and stands before the spirit; each of the three sacrificial meats on one stand, and millet and glutinous rice together on one tray.

sentences.zh: 尚儀以飯籩、胙俎西向以次進，皇后每受以授左右。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies advanced the rice tray and meat stands facing west in order; the empress received each and handed to attendants left and right.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies advanced the rice tray and meat stands from the west in order; the empress received each and handed them to attendants.

sentences.zh: 乃跪取爵，遂飲，卒爵，興，再拜，降自南陛，復于位。

translations.literal: Then she knelt, took the goblet, drank it to the end, rose, bowed twice, descended by the south steps, and returned to her place.
translations.idiomatic: Then she knelt, took the goblet, drank it dry, rose, bowed twice, descended the south steps, and returned to her place.

sentences.zh: 初，皇后獻將畢，典贊引貴妃詣罍洗，盥手，洗爵，自東陛升壇，酌盎齊于象尊，進神座前，北向跪，奠爵，興，少退，再拜。

translations.literal: At first, as the empress's offering was nearly complete, the Director of Praise led the honored consort to the urn washing-stand, washed her hands, washed the goblet, ascended the altar by the east steps, poured thick ale from the elephant vessel, advanced before the spirit seat, knelt facing north, placed the goblet, rose, withdrew slightly, and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: As the empress's offering neared completion, the Director of Praise led the honored consort to wash, ascended the east steps, poured thick ale from the elephant vessel, knelt before the spirit seat, placed the goblet, withdrew, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 尚儀以爵酌福酒進，貴妃再拜受爵，跪祭，遂飲，卒爵，再拜，降自東陛，復位。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies poured blessed wine and advanced; the honored consort bowed twice, received the goblet, knelt and offered a libation, then drank to the end, bowed twice, descended by the east steps, and returned to her place.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies poured blessed wine; the honored consort bowed twice, received the goblet, offered a libation, drank it dry, bowed twice, descended the east steps, and returned to her place.

sentences.zh: 昭儀終獻如亞獻。

translations.literal: The brilliant lady's final offering was like the secondary offering.
translations.idiomatic: The brilliant lady's final offering followed the secondary offering.

sentences.zh: 尚儀進神座前，跪徹豆。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies advanced before the spirit seat and knelt to remove the dou.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies advanced before the spirit seat and knelt to clear the dou.

sentences.zh: 司贊曰：「賜胙。

translations.literal: The Director of Praise said: "Grant the meat portions.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Praise said: "Grant the meat portions.

translations.literal: " The Praise Singer said: "All officers bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: " The Praise Singer said: "All officers bow twice.

translations.literal: " All in place bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: " All present bowed twice.

translations.literal: The Director of the Palace said: "Bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Palace said: "Bow twice.

translations.literal: " The empress bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: " The empress bowed twice.
