translations.literal: The Director of Praise said: "All officers bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Praise said: "All officers bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」在位者皆再拜。

translations.literal: " All in place bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: " All present bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 尚官請就望瘞位，司贊帥掌贊就瘞埳西南位，皇后至望瘞位，西向立。

translations.literal: The Director of the Palace requested proceeding to the distant-burial place; the Director of Praise led Praise Attendants to the southwest of the burial pit; the empress reached the distant-burial place and stood facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Palace asked to proceed to the distant-burial place; the Director of Praise led Praise Attendants to the burial pit's southwest; the empress stood there facing west.

sentences.zh: 尚儀執篚進神座前，取幣，自北陛降壇，西行詣瘞埳，以幣置於埳。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies advanced with the basket before the spirit seat, took silks, descended the altar by the north steps, went west to the burial pit, and placed the silks in the pit.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies took silks from before the spirit seat, descended the north steps, went west to the burial pit, and placed the silks in it.

sentences.zh: 司贊曰：「可瘞埳。

translations.literal: The Director of Praise said: "The pit may be buried.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Praise said: "The pit may be buried.

sentences.zh: 」東西各四人實土半埳。

translations.literal: " Four persons east and west each filled half the pit with earth.
translations.idiomatic: " Four persons on each side filled half the pit with earth.

sentences.zh: 尚宮曰：「禮畢，請就采桑位。

translations.literal: The Director of the Palace said: "The rite is complete; please proceed to the mulberry place.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Palace said: "The rite is complete; please proceed to the mulberry place.

sentences.zh: 」尚宮引皇后詣采桑壇，升自西陛，東向立。

translations.literal: " The Director of the Palace led the empress to the mulberry altar; she ascended by the west steps and stood facing east.
translations.idiomatic: " The Director of the Palace led the empress to the mulberry altar; she ascended the west steps and stood facing east.

sentences.zh: 初，皇后將詣望瘞位，司賓引內外命婦采桑者、執鉤筐者皆就位。

translations.literal: At first, when the empress was about to go to the distant-burial place, the Receptionist led inner and outer titled ladies who would pick mulberry and those holding hooks and baskets—all to take their places.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress was about to go to the distant-burial place, the Receptionist led inner and outer titled ladies who would pick mulberry and those with hooks and baskets to their places.

sentences.zh: 內外命婦一品各二人，二品、三品各一人。

translations.literal: For inner and outer titled ladies of the first rank, two each; of the second and third ranks, one each.
translations.idiomatic: First-rank inner and outer titled ladies, two each; second- and third-rank, one each.

sentences.zh: 皇后既至，尚功奉金鉤自北陛升，進。

translations.literal: When the empress had arrived, the Director of Works presented the gold hook, ascending by the north steps, and advanced.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress arrived, the Director of Works presented the gold hook, ascending the north steps.

sentences.zh: 典製奉筐從升。

translations.literal: The Director of Manufacture presented the basket and followed up.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Manufacture presented the basket and followed up.

sentences.zh: 皇后受鉤，采桑，典製以筐受之。

translations.literal: The empress received the hook, picked mulberry; the Director of Manufacture received it in the basket.
translations.idiomatic: The empress received the hook and picked mulberry; the Director of Manufacture received the leaves in the basket.

sentences.zh: 皇后采三條止，尚功前受鉤，典製以筐俱退。

translations.literal: When the empress had picked three sprays she stopped; the Director of Works advanced to receive the hook; the Director of Manufacture with the basket both withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: After three sprays the empress stopped; the Director of Works took the hook; the Director of Manufacture withdrew with the basket.

sentences.zh: 皇后初采桑，典製等各以鉤授內外命婦。

translations.literal: When the empress first picked mulberry, the Directors of Manufacture and others each gave hooks to inner and outer titled ladies.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress began picking, the Directors of Manufacture gave hooks to inner and outer titled ladies.

sentences.zh: 皇后采桑訖，內外命婦以次采，女史執筐者受之。

translations.literal: When the empress had finished picking mulberry, inner and outer titled ladies picked in turn; female scribes holding baskets received the leaves.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress finished, inner and outer titled ladies picked in turn; female scribes with baskets received the leaves.

sentences.zh: 內外命婦一品采五條，二品采九條，止，典製等受鉤，與執筐者退，復位。

translations.literal: First-rank inner and outer titled ladies picked five sprays; second-rank nine sprays, then stopped; the Directors of Manufacture received the hooks; those with baskets withdrew and returned to their places.
translations.idiomatic: First-rank ladies picked five sprays; second-rank nine, then stopped; the Directors of Manufacture took the hooks; basket-bearers withdrew to their places.

sentences.zh: 司賓各引內外命婦采桑者以從，至蠶室，尚功以桑授蠶母，蠶母切之以授婕妤食蠶，灑一𥴮止。

translations.literal: The Receptionist led each inner and outer titled lady who had picked mulberry to follow to the silkworm chamber; the Director of Works gave the mulberry to the silkworm mother; the silkworm mother cut it and gave it to the honorable lady who fed the silkworms, sprinkling one basketful and stopping.
translations.idiomatic: The Receptionist led mulberry-pickers to the silkworm chamber; the Director of Works gave the mulberry to the silkworm mother, who cut it for the honorable lady feeding the silkworms, one basketful and no more.

sentences.zh: 尚儀曰：「禮畢。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies said: "The rite is complete.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies said: "The rite is complete.

sentences.zh: 」尚宮引皇后還大次，內外命婦各還其次。

translations.literal: " The Director of the Palace led the empress back to the great tent; inner and outer titled ladies each returned to their tents.
translations.idiomatic: " The Director of the Palace led the empress back to the great tent; inner and outer titled ladies returned to their tents.

sentences.zh: 尚儀、典正以下俱復執事位。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies, Directors of Protocol, and below all returned to their duty places.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies, Directors of Protocol, and below all returned to their duty places.

sentences.zh: 司贊曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The Director of Praise said: "Bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Praise said: "Bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」尚儀以下皆再拜，出。

translations.literal: " The Director of Ceremonies and below all bowed twice and went out.
translations.idiomatic: " The Director of Ceremonies and below bowed twice and went out.

sentences.zh: 女工人以次出。

translations.literal: Female musicians went out in order.
translations.idiomatic: Female musicians went out in order.

sentences.zh: 其祝版燔於齊所。

translations.literal: The prayer board was burned at the abstinence site.
translations.idiomatic: The prayer board was burned at the abstinence site.

sentences.zh: 車駕還宮之明日，內外命婦設會於正殿，如元會之儀，命曰勞酒。

translations.literal: On the day after the imperial train returned to the palace, inner and outer titled ladies held a gathering in the principal hall, with ritual like the New Year's audience, named the consolation feast.
translations.idiomatic: The day after the train returned, inner and outer titled ladies held a gathering in the principal hall like the New Year's audience, called the consolation feast.

sentences.zh: 其有司歲所常祀者十有三：立春後丑日祀風師，立夏後申日祀雨師，立秋後辰日祀靈星，立冬後亥日祀司中、司命、司人、司祿，季夏土王之日祭中霤，孟冬祭司寒。

translations.literal: The regular annual sacrifices of the relevant offices numbered thirteen: after the Start of Spring, on the ox day, the Wind Master; after the Start of Summer, on the shen day, the Rain Master; after the Start of Autumn, on the chen day, the Spirit Star; after the Start of Winter, on the hai day, the Director of the Center, Director of Fate, Director of Humanity, and Director of Emolument; on the earth-king day of the last summer month, the central drain; in early winter, the winter cold.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen regular annual sacrifices: after Start of Spring, ox day for the Wind Master; after Start of Summer, shen day for the Rain Master; after Start of Autumn, chen day for the Spirit Star; after Start of Winter, hai day for the Directors of Center, Fate, Humanity, and Emolument; last summer month's earth-king day for the central drain; early winter for winter cold.

sentences.zh: 皆一獻。

translations.literal: All had a single offering.
translations.idiomatic: Each had a single offering.

sentences.zh: 祝稱：「天子謹遣。

translations.literal: The invoker said: "The Son of Heaven respectfully sends [this].
translations.idiomatic: The invoker said: "The Son of Heaven respectfully sends [this].

sentences.zh: 其中春、中秋釋奠于文宣王、武成王，皆以上丁、上戊，國學以祭酒、司業、博士三獻，樂以軒縣。

translations.literal: In mid-spring and mid-autumn libation was offered to the Cultured Propagation King and Martial Completion King, all on the upper ding and upper wu days; the National University used the Libationer, Vice Director, and Erudites as the three offerings; music used suspended bells of the hall type.
translations.idiomatic: In mid-spring and mid-autumn, libation was offered to the Cultured Propagation King and Martial Completion King on the upper ding and upper wu days; the National University used the Libationer, Vice Director, and Erudites as three offerings, with hall-type suspended bells.

sentences.zh: 前享一日，奉禮郎設三獻位于東門之內道北，執事位於道南，皆西向北上；

translations.literal: One day before the sacrifice, the Ritual Attendant set the three-offering places north of the path inside the east gate; attendant places south of the path, all facing west and advancing northward;
translations.idiomatic: One day before, the Ritual Attendant set three-offering places north of the path inside the east gate; attendant places south of the path, all facing west;

sentences.zh: 學官、館官位於縣東，當執事西南，西向，學生位於館官之後，皆重行北上；

translations.literal: academy officers and hostel officers east of the bells, southwest of the attendants, facing west; students behind the hostel officers, all in double ranks advancing northward;
translations.idiomatic: academy and hostel officers east of the bells, southwest of attendants, facing west; students behind hostel officers in double ranks;

sentences.zh: 觀者位於南門之內道之左右，重行北面，相對為首。

translations.literal: spectators left and right of the path inside the south gate, in double ranks facing north, opposite each other as the head.
translations.idiomatic: spectators left and right inside the south gate, in double ranks facing north opposite each other.

sentences.zh: 設三獻門外位於東門之外道南，執事位於其後，每等異位，北向西上；

translations.literal: Three-offering outer places south of the path outside the east gate; attendant places behind them, each rank at separate stations, facing north and advancing westward;
translations.idiomatic: Three-offering outer places south of the path outside the east gate; attendants behind in separate ranks facing north;

sentences.zh: 館官、學官位於三獻東南，北向西上。

translations.literal: hostel and academy officers southeast of the three offerings, facing north and advancing westward.
translations.idiomatic: hostel and academy officers southeast of the three offerings, facing north.

sentences.zh: 設先聖神座於廟室內西楹間，東向；

translations.literal: The Former Sage spirit seat was set between the western pillars inside the temple chamber, facing east;
translations.idiomatic: The Former Sage spirit seat was set between the western pillars inside the temple, facing east;

sentences.zh: 先師於先聖東北，南向；

translations.literal: the Former Master northeast of the Former Sage, facing south;
translations.idiomatic: the Former Master northeast of the Former Sage, facing south;

sentences.zh: 其餘弟子及二十一賢以次東陳，南向西上。

translations.literal: the remaining disciples and twenty-one sages arrayed east in order, facing south and advancing westward.
translations.idiomatic: remaining disciples and twenty-one sages arrayed east in order, facing south.

sentences.zh: 其餘皆如常祀。

translations.literal: The rest was as in regular sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The rest followed the regular sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 皇子束脩：束帛一篚，五匹；

translations.literal: The prince's initial gift: one basket of silk bundles, five bolts;
translations.idiomatic: The prince's initial gift: one basket of silk, five bolts;

sentences.zh: 酒一壺，二斗；

translations.literal: one jar of wine, two dou;
translations.idiomatic: one jar of wine, two dou;

sentences.zh: 脩一案，五脡。

translations.literal: one tray of dried meat, five strips.
translations.idiomatic: one tray of dried meat, five strips.

sentences.zh: 其日平明，皇子服學生之服其服青衿。

translations.literal: At daybreak that day, the prince wore the student's robe—the blue collar robe.
translations.idiomatic: At daybreak the prince wore student dress—the blue-collared robe.

sentences.zh: 至學門外。

translations.literal: He reached outside the academy gate.
translations.idiomatic: He reached outside the academy gate.

sentences.zh: 博士公服，執事者引立學堂東階上，西面。

translations.literal: The erudite in formal dress; attendants led him to stand on the east steps of the lecture hall, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The erudite in formal dress; attendants led him to the east steps of the lecture hall, facing west.

sentences.zh: 相者引皇子立於門東，西面。

translations.literal: The guide led the prince to stand east of the gate, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The guide led the prince east of the gate, facing west.

sentences.zh: 陳束帛篚、壺酒、脯案於皇子西南，當門北向，重行西上。

translations.literal: The silk basket, wine jar, and dried-meat tray were set southwest of the prince, north of the gate, in double ranks advancing westward.
translations.idiomatic: Silk basket, wine jar, and dried-meat tray were set southwest of the prince, north of the gate.

sentences.zh: 將命者出，立門西，東面，曰：「敢請就事。

translations.literal: The messenger came out, stood west of the gate facing east, and said: "I venture to request that you proceed with the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The messenger came out west of the gate facing east and said: "I venture to request that you proceed.

sentences.zh: 」皇子少進，曰：「某方受業於先生，敢請見。

translations.literal: " The prince advanced slightly and said: "I am about to receive instruction from the master; I venture to request an audience.
translations.idiomatic: " The prince advanced slightly and said: "I am about to receive instruction from the master; I venture to request an audience.

sentences.zh: 」將命者入告。

translations.literal: " The messenger entered to report.
translations.idiomatic: " The messenger entered to report.

sentences.zh: 博士曰：「某也不德，請皇子無辱。

translations.literal: The erudite said: "I lack virtue; I beg the prince not to demean himself.
translations.idiomatic: The erudite said: "I lack virtue; I beg the prince not to demean himself.

sentences.zh: 」若已封王，則云「請王無辱」。

translations.literal: " If already enfeoffed as king, it said, "I beg the king not to demean himself."
translations.idiomatic: " If already enfeoffed as king, it said, "I beg the king not to demean himself."

sentences.zh: 將命者出告，皇子固請。

translations.literal: The messenger came out to report; the prince firmly requested.
translations.idiomatic: The messenger reported; the prince insisted.

sentences.zh: 博士曰：「某也不德，請皇子就位，某敢見。

translations.literal: The erudite said: "I lack virtue; I beg the prince to take his place; I venture to receive him.
translations.idiomatic: The erudite said: "I lack virtue; I beg the prince to take his place; I venture to receive him.

sentences.zh: 」將命者出告，皇子曰：「某不敢以視賓客，請終賜見。

translations.literal: " The messenger came out to report; the prince said: "I dare not regard myself as a guest; I beg you finally to grant me an audience.
translations.idiomatic: " The messenger reported; the prince said: "I dare not treat myself as a guest; I beg you finally to grant an audience.

sentences.zh: 」將命者入告，博士曰：「某辭不得命，敢不從。

translations.literal: " The messenger entered to report; the erudite said: "Having declined I could not win release; I dare not disobey.
translations.idiomatic: " The messenger reported; the erudite said: "Having declined I could not win release; I dare not disobey.

sentences.zh: 」將命者出告，執篚者以篚東面授皇子，皇子執篚。

translations.literal: " The messenger came out to report; the basket-bearer gave the basket facing east to the prince; the prince held the basket.
translations.idiomatic: " The messenger reported; the basket-bearer gave the basket to the prince from the east; the prince held it.

sentences.zh: 博士降俟于東階下，西面。

translations.literal: The erudite descended to wait below the east steps, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The erudite descended to wait below the east steps, facing west.

sentences.zh: 相者引皇子，執事者奉壺酒、脩案以從，皇子入門而左，詣西階之南，東面。

translations.literal: The guide led the prince; attendants bore the wine jar and dried-meat tray following; the prince entered the gate to the left and went to the south of the west steps, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The guide led the prince; attendants bore wine and dried meat; the prince entered left to the south of the west steps, facing east.

sentences.zh: 奉酒、脩者立於皇子西南，東面北上。

translations.literal: Those bearing wine and dried meat stood southwest of the prince, facing east and advancing northward.
translations.idiomatic: Those bearing wine and dried meat stood southwest of the prince, facing east.

sentences.zh: 皇子跪，奠篚，再拜。

translations.literal: The prince knelt, placed the basket, and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The prince knelt, placed the basket, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 博士答再拜，皇子還避，遂進，跪取篚。

translations.literal: The erudite returned the double bow; the prince withdrew, then advanced and knelt to take the basket.
translations.idiomatic: The erudite returned the double bow; the prince withdrew, advanced, and knelt to take the basket.

sentences.zh: 相者引皇子進博士前，東面授幣，奉壺酒、脩案者從，奠於博士前，博士受幣，執事者取酒、脩、幣以東。

translations.literal: The guide led the prince forward before the erudite; facing east he presented the silks; those with wine and dried meat followed and placed them before the erudite; the erudite received the silks; attendants took wine, dried meat, and silks eastward.
translations.idiomatic: The guide led the prince before the erudite; facing east he presented silks; attendants placed wine and dried meat before the erudite, who received the silks; attendants took wine, dried meat, and silks eastward.

sentences.zh: 相者引皇子立於階間近南，北面，奉酒、脩者出。

translations.literal: The guide led the prince to stand in the space between the steps near the south, facing north; those with wine and dried meat went out.
translations.idiomatic: The guide led the prince between the steps near the south, facing north; wine and dried-meat bearers went out.

sentences.zh: 皇子拜訖，相者引皇子出。

translations.literal: When the prince had finished bowing, the guide led the prince out.
translations.idiomatic: When the prince had finished bowing, the guide led him out.

sentences.zh: 其學生束帛、酒、脩以見，如皇子。

translations.literal: Students' silk, wine, and dried meat for an audience were like the prince's.
translations.idiomatic: Students presented silk, wine, and dried meat as the prince did.

sentences.zh: 武德二年，始詔國子學立周公、孔子廟；

translations.literal: In the second year of Wude, an edict first ordered the National Academy to establish temples to the Duke of Zhou and Confucius;
translations.idiomatic: In Wude 2, an edict first ordered the National Academy to establish temples to the Duke of Zhou and Confucius;

sentences.zh: 七年，高祖釋奠焉，以周公為先聖，孔子配。

translations.literal: in the seventh year, Gaozu performed libation there, taking the Duke of Zhou as Former Sage and Confucius as associate.
translations.idiomatic: in year 7, Gaozu performed libation, taking the Duke of Zhou as Former Sage with Confucius as associate.

sentences.zh: 九年封孔子之後為褒聖侯。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Confucius's descendant was enfeoffed as Marquis who Exalts the Sage.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 Confucius's descendant was enfeoffed Marquis who Exalts the Sage.

sentences.zh: 貞觀二年，左僕射房玄齡、博士朱子奢建言：「周公、尼父俱聖人，然釋奠於學，以夫子也。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenguan, Left Vice Director Fang Xuanling and Erudite Zhu Zishe submitted: "The Duke of Zhou and the Master Ni were both sages, yet libation at the academy is for the Master.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenguan 2, Fang Xuanling and Zhu Zishe submitted: "The Duke of Zhou and Master Ni were both sages, yet academy libation is for the Master.

sentences.zh: 大業以前，皆孔丘為先聖，顏回為先師。

translations.literal: Before the Daye era, Kong Qiu was always Former Sage and Yan Hui Former Master.
translations.idiomatic: Before the Daye era, Kong Qiu was Former Sage and Yan Hui Former Master.

sentences.zh: 」乃罷周公，升孔子為先聖，以顏回配。

translations.literal: " Then the Duke of Zhou was removed and Confucius was raised to Former Sage, with Yan Hui as associate.
translations.idiomatic: " The Duke of Zhou was removed and Confucius raised to Former Sage, with Yan Hui as associate.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔州、縣學皆作孔子廟。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, an edict ordered prefectural and county academies all to build Confucius temples.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4, an edict ordered all prefectural and county academies to build Confucius temples.

sentences.zh: 十一年，詔尊孔子為宣父，作廟於兗州，給戶二十以奉之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, an edict honored Confucius as Exalted Father, built a temple in Yanzhou, and granted twenty households to support it.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11, an edict honored Confucius as Exalted Father, built a temple in Yanzhou, and granted twenty households for its support.

sentences.zh: 十四年，太宗觀釋奠於國子學，詔祭酒孔穎達講孝經。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Taizong observed libation at the National Academy and ordered Libationer Kong Yingda to lecture on the Classic of Filial Piety.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 Taizong observed libation at the National Academy and ordered Libationer Kong Yingda to lecture on the Classic of Filial Piety.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，詔左丘明、卜子夏、公羊高、穀梁赤、伏勝、高堂生、戴聖、毛萇、孔安國、劉向、鄭眾、賈逵、杜子春、馬融、盧植、鄭康成、服虔、何休、王肅、王弼、杜預、范甯二十二人皆以配享。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, an edict ordered Zuo Qiuming, Bu Zixia, Gongsun Gao, Guliang Chi, Fu Sheng, Gaotang Sheng, Dai Sheng, Mao Chang, Kong Anguo, Liu Xiang, Zheng Zhong, Jia Kui, Du Zichun, Ma Rong, Lu Zhi, Zheng Xuan, Fu Qian, He Xiu, Wang Su, Wang Bi, Du Yu, and Fan Ning—twenty-two men in all—to join in associated sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21, an edict ordered Zuo Qiuming, Bu Zixia, Gongsun Gao, Guliang Chi, Fu Sheng, Gaotang Sheng, Dai Sheng, Mao Chang, Kong Anguo, Liu Xiang, Zheng Zhong, Jia Kui, Du Zichun, Ma Rong, Lu Zhi, Zheng Xuan, Fu Qian, He Xiu, Wang Su, Wang Bi, Du Yu, and Fan Ning—twenty-two in all—for associated sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 而尼父廟學官自祭之，祝曰：「博士某昭告于先聖。

translations.literal: Yet at the Master's temple academy officers sacrificed on their own; the invoker said: "Erudite So-and-so respectfully announces to the Former Sage.
translations.idiomatic: Yet at the Master's temple academy officers sacrificed on their own; the invoker said: "Erudite So-and-so respectfully announces to the Former Sage.

sentences.zh: 」州、縣之釋奠，亦以博士祭。

translations.literal: " Prefectural and county libations were also performed by erudites.
translations.idiomatic: " Prefectural and county libations were also performed by erudites.

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎許敬宗等奏：「禮：『學官釋奠于其先師。

translations.literal: Central Secretariat Vice Director Xu Jingzong and others memorialized: "The Rites say: 'Academy officers perform libation to their Former Masters.'
translations.idiomatic: Xu Jingzong and others memorialized: "The Rites say: 'Academy officers perform libation to their Former Masters.'

sentences.zh: 』鄭氏謂：『詩、書、禮、樂之官也。

translations.literal: ' Zheng's commentary: 'Officers of the Odes, Documents, Rites, and Music.'
translations.idiomatic: ' Zheng's commentary: 'Officers of the Odes, Documents, Rites, and Music.'

sentences.zh: 』四時之學，將習其道，故釋奠各以其師，而不及先聖。

translations.literal: ' In the four seasons' studies, when about to practice their Way, libation was therefore to each one's master, and did not reach the Former Sage.
translations.idiomatic: ' In seasonal studies, when practicing their Way, libation was to each teacher, not the Former Sage.

sentences.zh: 惟春、秋合樂，則天子視學，有司總祭先聖、先師。

translations.literal: Only in spring and autumn, when music was combined, did the Son of Heaven inspect the academy and the relevant offices jointly sacrifice to the Former Sage and Former Masters.
translations.idiomatic: Only in spring and autumn, when music was combined, did the Son of Heaven inspect the academy and officers jointly sacrifice to Former Sage and Former Masters.

sentences.zh: 秦、漢釋奠無文，魏則以太常行事，晉、宋以學官主祭。

translations.literal: Qin and Han libation had no text; Wei then had the Director of the Imperial Clan perform it; Jin and Song had academy officers preside.
translations.idiomatic: Qin and Han libation had no text; Wei used the Director of the Imperial Clan; Jin and Song had academy officers preside.

sentences.zh: 且國學樂以軒縣，尊、俎須於官，非臣下所可專也。

translations.literal: Moreover, National Academy music used hall suspended bells; honored vessels and stands required officials—it was not something subordinates could monopolize.
translations.idiomatic: National Academy music used hall suspended bells; honored vessels required officials—subordinates could not monopolize it.

sentences.zh: 請國學釋奠以祭酒、司業、博士為三獻，辭稱『皇帝謹遣』。

translations.literal: We request that National Academy libation use the Libationer, Vice Director, and Erudite as the three offerings, with the phrase 'The emperor respectfully sends [this].'
translations.idiomatic: We request National Academy libation use Libationer, Vice Director, and Erudite as three offerings, with the phrase 'The emperor respectfully sends [this].'

sentences.zh: 州學以刺史、上佐、博士三獻，縣學以令、丞、主簿若尉三獻。

translations.literal: Prefectural academies used the prefect, senior aide, and erudite as three offerings; county academies used the magistrate, assistant, chief clerk, or captain as three offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural academies used prefect, senior aide, and erudite; county academies used magistrate, assistant, chief clerk, or captain.

sentences.zh: 如社祭，給明衣。

translations.literal: As at the soil-god sacrifice, bright garments were supplied.
translations.idiomatic: As at the soil-god sacrifice, bright garments were supplied.

sentences.zh: 」會皇太子釋奠，自為初獻，以祭酒張後胤亞獻，光州刺史攝司業趙弘智終獻。

translations.literal: " When the crown prince performed libation, he himself was the primary offering; Libationer Zhang Houyin was secondary offering; Guangzhou prefect acting as Vice Director Zhao Hongzhi was final offering.
translations.idiomatic: " When the crown prince performed libation, he was primary offering; Libationer Zhang Houyin secondary; Guangzhou prefect acting Vice Director Zhao Hongzhi final.

sentences.zh: 永徽中，復以周公為先聖、孔子為先師，顏回、左丘明以降皆從祀。

translations.literal: In the Yonghui era, the Duke of Zhou was again made Former Sage and Confucius Former Master; Yan Hui, Zuo Qiuming, and those below all joined associated sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yonghui era, the Duke of Zhou was again Former Sage and Confucius Former Master; Yan Hui, Zuo Qiuming, and those below joined associated sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 顯慶二年，太尉長孫无忌等言：「禮：『釋奠于其先師。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianqing, Grand Preceptor Zhangsun Wuji and others said: "The Rites: 'Perform libation to one's Former Master.'
translations.idiomatic: In Xianqing 2, Zhangsun Wuji and others said: "The Rites: 'Perform libation to one's Former Master.'

sentences.zh: 』若禮有高堂生，樂有制氏，詩有毛公，書有伏生。

translations.literal: ' If for Rites there was Master Gaotang, for Music the Zhi clan, for Odes Master Mao, for Documents Master Fu.
translations.idiomatic: ' For Rites there was Master Gaotang, for Music the Zhi clan, for Odes Master Mao, for Documents Master Fu.

sentences.zh: 又禮：『始立學，釋奠于先聖。

translations.literal: Again the Rites: 'When the academy is first established, perform libation to the Former Sage.'
translations.idiomatic: Again: 'When the academy is first established, perform libation to the Former Sage.'

sentences.zh: 』鄭氏注：『若周公、孔子也。

translations.literal: ' Zheng's note: 'Such as the Duke of Zhou or Confucius.'
translations.idiomatic: ' Zheng's note: 'Such as the Duke of Zhou or Confucius.'

sentences.zh: 』故貞觀以夫子為聖，眾儒為先師。

translations.literal: ' Hence in Zhenguan the Master was sage and the many scholars Former Masters.
translations.idiomatic: ' Hence in Zhenguan the Master was sage and the many scholars Former Masters.

sentences.zh: 且周公作禮樂，當同王者之祀。

translations.literal: Moreover the Duke of Zhou made rites and music and should share the king's sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Duke of Zhou made rites and music and should share royal sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 」乃以周公配武王，而孔子為先聖。

translations.literal: " Then the Duke of Zhou was associated with King Wu, and Confucius was Former Sage.
translations.idiomatic: " The Duke of Zhou was associated with King Wu, and Confucius was Former Sage.

sentences.zh: 總章元年，太子弘釋奠于學，贈顏回為太子少師，曾參少保。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zongzhang, Crown Prince Hong performed libation at the academy; Yan Hui was posthumously made Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince and Zeng Shen Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: In Zongzhang 1, Crown Prince Hong performed libation at the academy; Yan Hui was made Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince and Zeng Shen Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 咸亨元年，詔州、縣皆營孔子廟。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianheng, an edict ordered all prefectures and counties to build Confucius temples.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianheng 1, an edict ordered all prefectures and counties to build Confucius temples.

sentences.zh: 武后天授元年，封周公為褒德王，孔子為隆道公。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianshou under Empress Wu, the Duke of Zhou was enfeoffed as King of Exalted Virtue and Confucius as Duke of Elevated Way.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshou 1 under Empress Wu, the Duke of Zhou was enfeoffed King of Exalted Virtue and Confucius Duke of Elevated Way.

sentences.zh: 神龍元年，以鄒、魯百戶為隆道公采邑，以奉歲祀，子孫世襲褒聖侯。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shenlong, a hundred households of Zou and Lu were made the fief of the Duke of Elevated Way to support annual sacrifice; descendants hereditarily held the title Marquis who Exalts the Sage.
translations.idiomatic: In Shenlong 1, a hundred households of Zou and Lu were the Duke of Elevated Way's fief for annual sacrifice; descendants hereditarily held Marquis who Exalts the Sage.

sentences.zh: 睿宗太極元年，以兗州隆道公近祠戶三十供灑掃，加贈顏回太子太師，曾參太子太保，皆配享。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taiji under Ruizong, thirty nearby sacrifice households of Yanzhou's Duke of Elevated Way were supplied for sweeping; Yan Hui was further posthumously made Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince and Zeng Shen Grand Guardian—both joined associated sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiji 1 under Ruizong, thirty nearby Yanzhou households swept the shrine; Yan Hui was made Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince and Zeng Shen Grand Guardian—both joined associated sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 玄宗開元七年，皇太子齒冑於學，謁先聖，詔宋璟亞獻，蘇頲終獻。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Kaiyuan under Xuanzong, the crown prince donned cap and armor at the academy and visited the Former Sage; Song Jing was ordered as secondary offering and Su Ting as final offering.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaiyuan 7, the crown prince donned cap and armor at the academy and visited the Former Sage; Song Jing was secondary offering and Su Ting final.

sentences.zh: 臨享，天子思齒冑義，乃詔二獻皆用冑子，祀先聖如釋奠。

translations.literal: At the approaching sacrifice the Son of Heaven reflected on the meaning of donning cap and armor and then ordered both secondary offerings to use cap-and-armor youths; sacrifice to the Former Sage was as at libation.
translations.idiomatic: At the approaching sacrifice the emperor reflected on donning cap and armor and ordered both secondary offerings to use cap-and-armor youths; sacrifice to the Former Sage followed libation.

sentences.zh: 右散騎常侍褚无量講孝經、禮記文王世子篇。

translations.literal: Right Gentleman-in-Attendance Chu Wuliang lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety and the "King Wen's Heir" chapter of the Record of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Right Gentleman-in-Attendance Chu Wuliang lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety and the "King Wen's Heir" chapter of the Record of Rites.

sentences.zh: 明年，司業李元瓘奏：「先聖廟為十哲象，以先師顏子配，則配象當坐，今乃立侍。

translations.literal: The next year, Vice Director Li Yuanjin memorialized: "The Former Sage temple has images of the Ten Sages; with Former Master Yanzi as associate, the associate image should sit, but now stands in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, Vice Director Li Yuanjin memorialized: "The Former Sage temple has Ten Sage images; with Former Master Yanzi as associate, the associate image should sit, but now stands in attendance.

sentences.zh: 餘弟子列象廟堂不豫享，而范甯等皆從祀。

translations.literal: Remaining disciples are imaged in the hall but do not join the feast, while Fan Ning and others all join associated sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Remaining disciples are imaged in the hall but do not join the feast, while Fan Ning and others join associated sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 請釋奠十哲享於上，而圖七十子於壁。

translations.literal: We request that at libation the Ten Sages feast above, and the seventy disciples be painted on the walls.
translations.idiomatic: We request that at libation the Ten Sages feast above, and the seventy disciples be painted on the walls.

sentences.zh: 曾參以孝受經於夫子，請享之如二十二賢。

translations.literal: Zeng Shen received the classic through filial piety from the Master; we request he feast like the twenty-two sages.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Shen received the classic through filial piety from the Master; we request he feast like the twenty-two sages.

sentences.zh: 」乃詔十哲為坐象，悉豫祀。

translations.literal: " Then an edict made the Ten Sages seated images, all joining the feast.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict made the Ten Sages seated images, all joining the feast.

sentences.zh: 曾參特為之象，坐亞之。

translations.literal: Zeng Shen alone had a special image, seated as associate.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Shen alone had a special image, seated as associate.

sentences.zh: 圖七十子及二十二賢於廟壁。

translations.literal: The seventy disciples and twenty-two sages were painted on the temple walls.
translations.idiomatic: The seventy disciples and twenty-two sages were painted on the temple walls.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，詔夫子既稱先聖，可謚曰文宣王，遣三公持節冊命，以其嗣為文宣公，任州長史，代代勿絕。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, an edict: since the Master was already called Former Sage, he could be posthumously titled Cultured Propagation King; the Three Excellencies were sent with staffs of office to invest him; his heir was made Cultured Propagation Duke, holding prefectural governorship, generation after generation without end.
translations.idiomatic: In year 27, an edict: since the Master was Former Sage, he could be posthumously titled Cultured Propagation King; the Three Excellencies invested him; his heir was Cultured Propagation Duke with prefectural governorship, generation after generation without end.

sentences.zh: 先時，孔廟以周公南面，而夫子坐西墉下。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the Confucius temple the Duke of Zhou faced south, while the Master sat below the west wall.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in the Confucius temple the Duke of Zhou faced south while the Master sat below the west wall.

sentences.zh: 貞觀中，廢周公祭，而夫子位未改。

translations.literal: In Zhenguan the Duke of Zhou sacrifice was abolished, but the Master's place was not changed.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenguan the Duke of Zhou sacrifice was abolished, but the Master's place was unchanged.

sentences.zh: 至是，二京國子監、天下州縣夫子始皆南向，以顏淵配。

translations.literal: By then the Masters in both capitals' Directorate of Education and all prefectures and counties under heaven first all faced south, with Yan Yuan as associate.
translations.idiomatic: By then Masters in both capitals' Directorate and all prefectures and counties first faced south, with Yan Yuan as associate.

sentences.zh: 贈諸弟子爵公侯：子淵兗公，子騫費侯，伯牛鄆侯，仲弓薛侯，子有徐侯，子路衞侯，子我齊侯，子貢黎侯，子游吳侯，子夏魏侯。

translations.literal: Disciples were enfeoffed with duke and marquis titles: Zi Yuan Duke of Yan, Zi Qian Marquis of Fei, Ran Geng Marquis of Yun, Zhong Gong Marquis of Xue, Zi You Marquis of Xu, Zi Lu Marquis of Wei, Zi Wo Marquis of Qi, Zi Gong Marquis of Li, Zi You Marquis of Wu, Zi Xia Marquis of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Disciples were enfeoffed: Zi Yuan Duke of Yan, Zi Qian Marquis of Fei, Ran Geng Marquis of Yun, Zhong Gong Marquis of Xue, Zi You Marquis of Xu, Zi Lu Marquis of Wei, Zi Wo Marquis of Qi, Zi Gong Marquis of Li, Zi You Marquis of Wu, Zi Xia Marquis of Wei.

sentences.zh: 又贈曾參以降六十七人：參成伯，顓孫師陳伯，澹臺滅明江伯，密子賤單伯，原憲原伯，公冶長莒伯，南宮适郯伯，公晳哀郳伯，曾點宿伯，顏路𣏌伯，商瞿蒙伯，高柴共伯，漆雕開滕伯，公伯寮任伯，司馬牛向伯，樊遲樊伯，有若卞伯，公西赤邵伯，巫馬期鄫伯，梁鱣梁伯，顏柳蕭伯，冉孺郜伯，曹卹豐伯，伯虔鄒伯，公孫龍黃伯，冉季產東平伯，秦子南少梁伯，漆雕斂武城伯，顏子驕琅邪伯，漆雕徒父須句伯，壤駟赤北徵伯，商澤睢陽伯，石作蜀郈邑伯，任不齊任城伯，公夏首亢父伯，公良孺東牟伯，后處營丘伯，秦開彭衙伯，奚容蒧下邳伯，公肩定新田伯，顏襄臨沂伯，鄡單銅鞮伯，句井彊淇陽伯，罕父黑乘丘伯，秦商上洛伯，申黨召陵伯，公祖子之期思伯，榮子旗雩婁伯，縣成鉅野伯，左人郢臨淄伯，燕伋漁陽伯，鄭子徒滎陽伯，秦非汧陽伯，施常乘氏伯，顏噲朱虛伯，步叔乘淳于伯，顏之僕東武伯，原亢籍萊蕪伯，樂欬昌平伯，廉絜莒父伯，顏何開陽伯，叔仲會瑕丘伯，狄黑臨濟伯，邽巽平陸伯，孔忠汶陽伯，公西與如重丘伯，公西蒧祝阿伯。

translations.literal: Zeng Shen and sixty-seven men below were also enfeoffed: Shen as Earl of Cheng, Zhuan Sun Shi Earl of Chen, Tantai Mieming Earl of Jiang, Mi Zijian Earl of Dan, Yuan Xian Earl of Yuan, Gongye Chang Earl of Ju, Nangong Kuo Earl of Tan, Gongxi Ai Earl of Xing, Zeng Dian Earl of Su, Yan Lu Earl of Ji, Shang Qu Earl of Meng, Gao Chai Earl of Gong, Qi Diao Kai Earl of Teng, Gongbo Liao Earl of Ren, Sima Niu Earl of Xiang, Fan Chi Earl of Fan, You Ruo Earl of Bian, Gongxi Chi Earl of Shao, Wuma Qi Earl of Zeng, Liang Yu Earl of Liang, Yan Liu Earl of Xiao, Ran Ru Earl of Gao, Cao Xiu Earl of Feng, Bo Qian Earl of Zou, Gongsun Long Earl of Huang, Ran Ji Earl of Dongping, Qin Zinan Earl of Shaoliang, Qi Diao Jian Earl of Wucheng, Yan Zijiao Earl of Langye, Qi Diao Tufu Earl of Xuju, Rang Si Chi Earl of Beizheng, Shang Ze Earl of Suiyang, Shi Zuo Shu Earl of Zouyi, Ren Buqi Earl of Rencheng, Gong Xia Shou Earl of Kangfu, Gongliang Ru Earl of Dongmou, Hou Chu Earl of Yingqiu, Qin Kai Earl of Pengya, Xi Rong Chan Earl of Xiapi, Gongjian Ding Earl of Xintian, Yan Xiang Earl of Linyi, Wu Dan Earl of Tongdi, Gou Jingqiang Earl of Qiyang, Hanfu Hei Earl of Chengqiu, Qin Shang Earl of Shangluo, Shen Dang Earl of Zhaoling, Gongzu Zizhi Earl of Qisi, Rong Ziqi Earl of Yulou, Xian Cheng Earl of Juye, Zuoren Ying Earl of Linzi, Yan Ji Earl of Yuyang, Zheng Zitu Earl of Xingyang, Qin Fei Earl of Qianyang, Shi Chang Earl of Chengshi, Yan Kuai Earl of Zhuxu, Bu Shucheng Earl of Chunyu, Yan Zhipu Earl of Dongwu, Yuan Kang Earl of Laiwu, Yue Ke Earl of Changping, Lian Jie Earl of Jufu, Yan He Earl of Kaiyang, Shu Zhong Hui Earl of Xiaqiu, Di Hei Earl of Linji, Ju Sun Earl of Pinglu, Kong Zhong Earl of Wenyang, Gongxi Yuru Earl of Chongqiu, Gongxi Chi Earl of Zhu'e.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Shen and sixty-seven below were also enfeoffed with earldoms and baronies across the realm—for example Shen as Earl of Cheng, Zhuan Sun Shi Earl of Chen, Tantai Mieming Earl of Jiang, down through Gongxi Chi Earl of Zhu'e.

sentences.zh: 於是二京之祭，牲太牢、樂宮縣、舞六佾矣。

translations.literal: Thereupon sacrifices in both capitals used the great victim, palace suspended music, and the six rows dance.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon both capitals used the great victim, palace suspended music, and six-row dance.

sentences.zh: 州縣之牲以少牢而無樂。

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties used the lesser victim and had no music.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties used the lesser victim and had no music.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，詔春秋二仲上丁，以三公攝事，若會大祀，則用中丁，州、縣之祭，上丁。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, an edict: in spring and autumn on the upper ding of each season, the Three Excellencies would preside; if a great sacrifice coincided, the middle ding was used; prefectural and county sacrifices used the upper ding.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28, an edict: spring and autumn upper ding, the Three Excellencies presided; if a great sacrifice coincided, the middle ding; prefectures and counties used upper ding.

sentences.zh: 上元元年，肅宗以歲旱罷中、小祀，而文宣之祭，至仲秋猶祠之於太學。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shangyuan, Suzong because of yearly drought suspended middle and minor sacrifices, but the Cultured Propagation sacrifice still in mid-autumn was offered at the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In Shangyuan 1, Suzong suspended middle and minor sacrifices for drought, but the Cultured Propagation sacrifice was still offered at the Imperial Academy in mid-autumn.

sentences.zh: 永泰二年八月，脩國學祠堂成，祭酒蕭昕始奏釋奠，宰相元載、杜鴻漸、李抱玉及常參官、六軍將軍就觀焉。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year of Yongtai, when the Imperial Academy ancestral hall was completed, Libationer Xiao Xin first performed libation; Chancellors Yuan Zai, Du Hongjian, Li Baoyu, regular attendees, and generals of the Six Armies came to observe.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongtai 2.8, when the Imperial Academy hall was completed, Libationer Xiao Xin first performed libation; Chancellors Yuan Zai, Du Hongjian, Li Baoyu, regular attendees, and Six Armies generals observed.

sentences.zh: 自復二京，惟正會之樂用宮縣，郊廟之享，登歌而已，文、武二舞亦不能具。

translations.literal: Since the two capitals were recovered, only at the great audience was palace suspended music used; at suburban and temple feasts there was ascending song only, and the civil and martial two dances could not be fully supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Since recovering the two capitals, only the great audience used palace suspended music; suburban and temple feasts had ascending song only, and civil and martial dances could not be fully supplied.

sentences.zh: 至是，魚朝恩典監事，乃奏宮縣於論堂，而雜以教坊工伎。

translations.literal: By then Yu Chaoen, acting as supervisor, performed palace suspended music in the lecture hall, mixed with artisans of the Instruction Workshop.
translations.idiomatic: By then Yu Chaoen performed palace suspended music in the lecture hall, mixed with Instruction Workshop artisans.

sentences.zh: 貞元九年季冬，貢舉人謁先師日與親享廟同，有司言上丁釋奠與大祠同，即用中丁，乃更用日謁於學。

translations.literal: In the last month of winter in the ninth year of Zhenyuan, the day examination candidates visited the Former Master coincided with the emperor's personal temple feast; the relevant offices said upper-ding libation equaled a great sacrifice and therefore used the middle ding; thereafter they changed to visiting the academy on a [regular] day.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyuan 9 last winter month, examination candidates' visit to the Former Master coincided with the emperor's personal temple feast; officers said upper-ding libation equaled a great sacrifice and used middle ding; thereafter they visited on a regular day.

sentences.zh: 元和九年，禮部奏貢舉人謁先師，自是不復行矣。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Yuanhe, the Ministry of Rites memorialized that examination candidates visiting the Former Master would from then on not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanhe 9, the Ministry of Rites memorialized that examination candidates visiting the Former Master would no longer be carried out.

sentences.zh: 開元十九年，始置太公尚父廟，以留侯張良配。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Kaiyuan, the temple of the Grand Duke and Fatherly Lord was first established, with Marquis of Liu Zhang Liang as associate.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaiyuan 19, the Grand Duke and Fatherly Lord temple was first established, with Marquis of Liu Zhang Liang as associate.

sentences.zh: 中春、中秋上戊祭之，牲、樂之制如文宣。

translations.literal: In mid-spring and mid-autumn on the upper wu it was sacrificed to; victim and music regulations were like the Cultured Propagation King.
translations.idiomatic: In mid-spring and mid-autumn on upper wu it was sacrificed to; victim and music followed the Cultured Propagation King.

sentences.zh: 出師命將，發日引辭于廟。

translations.literal: When troops were ordered out, on the day of departure farewell was taken at the temple.
translations.idiomatic: When troops were ordered out, farewell was taken at the temple on the departure day.

sentences.zh: 仍以古名將十人為十哲配享。

translations.literal: Ancient famous generals of ten men were still made the Ten Sages for associated sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Ten ancient famous generals were made the Ten Sages for associated sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 天寶六載，詔諸州武舉人上省，先謁太公廟。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tianbao, an edict ordered military examination candidates from all prefectures going to the capital first to visit the Grand Duke temple.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianbao 6, an edict ordered military examination candidates from all prefectures to visit the Grand Duke temple before reaching the capital.

sentences.zh: 乾元元年，太常少卿于休烈奏：「秋享漢祖廟，旁無侍臣，而太公乃以張良配。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianyuan, Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Yu Xiulie memorialized: "In autumn the Han Founder temple is feasted, with no attendant lords at the side, yet the Grand Duke has Zhang Liang as associate.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianyuan 1, Yu Xiulie memorialized: "In autumn the Han Founder temple is feasted without attendant lords, yet the Grand Duke has Zhang Liang as associate.

sentences.zh: 子房生漢初，佐高祖定天下，時不與太公接。

translations.literal: Zifang was born in early Han, assisted Gaozu to settle the realm, and in his time had no contact with the Grand Duke.
translations.idiomatic: Zifang was born in early Han, assisted Gaozu to settle the realm, and never met the Grand Duke.

sentences.zh: 古配食廟庭。

translations.literal: In antiquity associated feasting was in the temple court.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity associated feasting was in the temple court.

sentences.zh: 皆其佐命；

translations.literal: All were those who aided his mandate;
translations.idiomatic: All were those who aided the mandate;

sentences.zh: 太公，人臣也，誼無配享。

translations.literal: the Grand Duke, a human subject, by right had no associated sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: the Grand Duke, a subject, by right had no associated sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 請以張良配漢祖廟。

translations.literal: We request Zhang Liang be associated with the Han Founder temple.
translations.idiomatic: We request Zhang Liang be associated with the Han Founder temple.

sentences.zh: 上元元年，尊太公為武成王，祭典與文宣王比，以歷代良將為十哲象坐侍。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shangyuan, the Grand Duke was honored as Martial Completion King; sacrifice regulations matched the Cultured Propagation King, with famous generals of successive ages as Ten Sage images seated in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: In Shangyuan 1, the Grand Duke was honored as Martial Completion King; sacrifice matched the Cultured Propagation King, with famous generals of successive ages as seated Ten Sage images.

sentences.zh: 秦武安君白起、漢淮陰侯韓信、蜀丞相諸葛亮、唐尚書右僕射衞國公李靖、司空英國公李勣列於左，漢太子少傅張良、齊大司馬田穰苴、吳將軍孫武、魏西河守吳起、燕昌國君樂毅列於右，以良為配。

translations.literal: Qin Martial Lord Bai Qi, Han Huaiyin Marquis Han Xin, Shu Chancellor Zhuge Liang, Tang Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Duke of Wei Li Jing, and Minister of Works Duke of Ying Li Ji were arrayed on the left; Han Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince Zhang Liang, Qi Grand Marshal Tian Rangju, Wu General Sun Wu, Wei Defender of Xihe Wu Qi, and Yan Lord of Chang Le Yue Yi on the right, with Liang as associate.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Martial Lord Bai Qi, Han Huaiyin Marquis Han Xin, Shu Chancellor Zhuge Liang, Tang Right Vice Director Duke of Wei Li Jing, and Minister of Works Duke of Ying Li Ji on the left; Han Junior Tutor Zhang Liang, Qi Grand Marshal Tian Rangju, Wu General Sun Wu, Wei Defender of Xihe Wu Qi, and Yan Lord of Chang Le Yue Yi on the right, with Liang as associate.

sentences.zh: 後罷中祀，遂不祭。

translations.literal: Later middle sacrifices were suspended and it was no longer sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: Later middle sacrifices were suspended and it was no longer offered.

sentences.zh: 建中三年，禮儀使顏真卿奏：「治武成廟，請如月令春、秋釋奠。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianzhong, Ritual Commissioner Yan Zhenqing memorialized: "In repairing the Martial Completion temple, we request libation as in the Monthly Ordinances for spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianzhong 3, Yan Zhenqing memorialized: "In repairing the Martial Completion temple, we request spring and autumn libation as in the Monthly Ordinances.

sentences.zh: 其追封以王，宜用諸侯之數，樂奏軒縣。

translations.literal: Since posthumous enfeoffment as king should use the regulations for feudal lords, music should perform hall suspended bells.
translations.idiomatic: Since posthumous enfeoffment as king should use feudal-lord regulations, music should use hall suspended bells.

sentences.zh: 」詔史館考定可配享者，列古今名將凡六十四人圖形焉：越相國范蠡，齊將孫臏，趙信平君廉頗，秦將王翦，漢相國平陽侯曹參、左丞相絳侯周勃、前將軍北平太守李廣、大司馬冠軍侯霍去病，後漢太傅高密侯鄧禹、左將軍膠東侯賈復、執金吾雍奴侯寇恂、伏波將軍新息侯馬援、太尉槐里侯皇甫嵩，魏征東將軍晉陽侯張遼，蜀前將軍漢壽亭侯關羽，吳偏將軍南郡太守周瑜、丞相婁侯陸遜，晉征南大將軍南城侯羊祜、撫軍大將軍襄陽侯王濬，東晉車騎將軍康樂公謝玄，前燕太宰錄尚書太原王慕容恪，宋司空武陵公檀道濟，梁太尉永寧郡公王僧辯，北齊尚書右僕射燕郡公慕容紹宗，周大冢宰齊王宇文憲，隋上柱國新義公韓擒虎、柱國太平公史萬歲，唐右武候大將軍鄂國公尉遲敬德、右武衞大將軍邢國公蘇定方、右武衞大將軍同中書門下平章事韓國公張仁亶、兵部尚書同中書門下三品中山公王晙、夏官尚書同中書門下三品朔方大總管王孝傑；

translations.literal: " An edict ordered the History Office to determine those fit for associated sacrifice and list famous generals ancient and modern, sixty-four in all, with images: Yue Chancellor Fan Li, Qi General Sun Bin, Zhao Lord of Xinping Lian Po, Qin General Wang Jian, Han Chancellor Marquis of Pingyang Cao Shen, Left Chancellor Marquis of Jiang Zhou Bo, Front General Defender of Beiping Li Guang, Grand Marshal Marquis Who Conquers Champions Huo Qubing, Later Han Grand Tutor Marquis of Gaomi Deng Yu, Left General Marquis of Jiaodong Jia Fu, Commandant of the Imperial Clan Marquis of Yongnu Kou Xun, Wave-Calming General Marquis of Xinxie Ma Yuan, Grand Commandant Marquis of Huaili Huangfu Song, Wei General Who Pacifies the East Marquis of Jinyang Zhang Liao, Shu Front General Marquis of Hanshou Guan Yu, Wu Partial General Defender of Nanjun Zhou Yu, Chancellor Marquis of Lou Lu Xun, Jin General Who Pacifies the South Marquis of Nancheng Yang Hu, Pacifying Army Grand General Marquis of Xiangyang Wang Jun, Eastern Jin Cavalry General Duke of Kangle Xie Xuan, Former Yan Grand Steward Recorder of the Secretariat Taiyuan King Murong Ke, Song Minister of Works Duke of Wuling Tan Daoji, Liang Grand Commandant Duke of Yongning Wang Sengbian, Northern Qi Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Duke of Yancheng Murong Shaozong, Zhou Grand Steward Prince of Qi Yuwen Xian, Sui Upper Pillar of State Duke of Xinyi Han Qinhu, Pillar of State Duke of Taiping Shi Wansui, Tang Right Martial Guard General Duke of E Yuchi Jingde, Right Martial Guard General Duke of Xing Su Dingfang, Right Martial Guard General Same Rank as Secretariat Second Class Duke of Han Zhang Renyuan, Minister of War Same Rank as Secretariat Third Class Duke of Zhongshan Wang Jun, Summer Official Minister Same Rank as Secretariat Third Class Defender-General of Shuofang Wang Xiaojie;

sentences.zh: 齊相管仲、安平君田單，趙馬服君趙奢、大將軍武安君李牧，漢梁王彭越、太尉條侯周亞夫、大將軍長平侯衞青、後將軍營平侯趙充國，後漢大司馬廣平侯吳漢、征西大將軍夏陽侯馮異、建威大將軍好畤侯耿弇、太尉新豐侯段熲，魏太尉鄧艾，蜀車騎將軍西鄉侯張飛，吳武威將軍南郡太守孱陵侯呂蒙、大司馬荊州牧陸抗，晉鎮南大將軍當陽侯杜預、太尉長沙公陶偘，前秦丞相王猛，後魏太尉北平王長孫嵩，宋征虜將軍王鎮惡，陳司空南平公吳明徹，北齊右丞相咸陽王斛律光，周太傅大宗伯燕國公于謹、右僕射鄖國公韋孝寬，隋司空尚書令越國公楊素、右武候大將軍宋國公賀若弼，唐司空河間郡王孝恭、禮部尚書聞喜公裴行儉、兵部尚書同中書門下三品代國公郭元振、朔方節度使兼御史大夫張齊丘、太尉中書令尚父汾陽郡王郭子儀。

sentences.zh: 貞元二年，刑部尚書關播奏：「太公古稱大賢，下乃置亞聖，義有未安。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyuan, Minister of Justice Guan Bo memorialized: "The Grand Duke was anciently called a great sage; to place him as Associate Sage is not proper in meaning.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyuan 2, Guan Bo memorialized: "The Grand Duke was anciently called a great sage; making him Associate Sage is improper.

sentences.zh: 而仲尼十哲，皆當時弟子，今以異時名將，列之弟子，非類也。

translations.literal: Yet Confucius's Ten Sages were all disciples of the time; now famous generals of another age are ranked among disciples—it is not of a kind.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Confucius's Ten Sages were disciples of his time; ranking generals of another age among disciples is incongruous.

sentences.zh: 請但用古今名將配享，去亞聖十哲之名。

translations.literal: We request only famous generals ancient and modern for associated sacrifice, removing the Associate Sage and Ten Sages titles.
translations.idiomatic: We request only famous generals ancient and modern for associated sacrifice, removing Associate Sage and Ten Sages titles.

sentences.zh: 」自是，唯享武成王及留侯，而諸將不復祭矣。

translations.literal: " From then on only the Martial Completion King and the Marquis of Liu were feasted, and the generals were no longer sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: " From then on only the Martial Completion King and Marquis of Liu were feasted; the generals were no longer sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 四年，兵部侍郎李紓言：「開元中，太公廟以張良配，以太常卿、少卿三獻，祝文曰：『皇帝遣某敢昭告。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Vice Minister of War Li Shu said: "In Kaiyuan the Grand Duke temple had Zhang Liang as associate, with the Director of the Imperial Clan and Vice Director as the three offerings; the prayer said: 'The emperor sends So-and-so to respectfully announce.'
translations.idiomatic: In year 4, Li Shu said: "In Kaiyuan the Grand Duke temple had Zhang Liang as associate, with Director of the Imperial Clan and Vice Director as three offerings; the prayer said: 'The emperor sends So-and-so to respectfully announce.'

sentences.zh: 』至上元元年贈太公以王爵，祭典同文宣，有司遂以太尉獻，祝版親署。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shangyuan the Grand Duke was posthumously given a king's title; sacrifice regulations matched the Cultured Propagation King; the relevant offices then used the Grand Commandant as offering, and the prayer board bore the emperor's own signature.
translations.idiomatic: In Shangyuan 1 the Grand Duke received a king's title; sacrifice matched the Cultured Propagation King; officers then used the Grand Commandant as offering and the prayer board bore the emperor's signature.

sentences.zh: 夫太公周之太師，張良漢之少傅，今至尊屈禮於臣佐，神何敢歆？

translations.literal: The Grand Duke was Zhou's Grand Tutor; Zhang Liang was Han's Junior Tutor—now the supreme sovereign bends ritual toward a ministerial aide; how dare the spirit receive it?
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Duke was Zhou's Grand Tutor; Zhang Liang was Han's Junior Tutor—now the sovereign bends ritual toward a ministerial aide; how dare the spirit receive it?

sentences.zh: 且文宣百世所宗，故樂以宮縣，獻以太尉，尊師崇道也。

translations.literal: Moreover the Cultured Propagation King is honored for a hundred generations; therefore music uses palace suspended bells and the offering is the Grand Commandant—honoring the teacher and exalting the Way.
translations.idiomatic: The Cultured Propagation King is honored for a hundred generations; therefore music uses palace suspended bells and the Grand Commandant offers—honoring the teacher and exalting the Way.

sentences.zh: 太公述作止六韜，勳業著一代，請祝辭不進署，改昭告為敬祭，留侯為致祭，獻官用太常卿以下。

translations.literal: The Grand Duke's writings stop at the Six Secret Strategies; merit stands for one age—we request the prayer text not bear the emperor's signature, change 'announce' to 'respectfully sacrifice,' the Marquis of Liu make the offering, and offering officers from Vice Director of the Imperial Clan downward.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Duke's writings stop at the Six Secret Strategies; merit stands for one age—we request the prayer not bear the emperor's signature, change 'announce' to 'respectfully sacrifice,' the Marquis of Liu make the offering, and officers from Vice Director of the Imperial Clan downward.

sentences.zh: 」百官議之，多請如紓言。

translations.literal: " The hundred officials debated; most requested as Shu said.
translations.idiomatic: " Officials debated; most requested as Shu said.

sentences.zh: 左司郎中嚴涗等議曰：「按紓援典訓尊卑之節，當矣，抑猶有未盡。

translations.literal: Left Bureau Director Yan Jun and others debated: "According to Shu's citation of canonical instruction on the gradations of honor and humility, it is fitting, yet still not complete.
translations.idiomatic: Left Bureau Director Yan Jun and others debated: "According to Shu's citation of canonical gradations of honor, it is fitting, yet still incomplete.

sentences.zh: 夫大名徽號，不容虛美，而太公兵權奇計之人耳，當殷之失德，諸侯歸周，遂為佐命。

translations.literal: Great names and emblematic titles cannot bear empty praise; the Grand Duke was merely a man of military stratagem and odd schemes—when Yin lost virtue, the feudal lords returned to Zhou and he became one who aided the mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Great names cannot bear empty praise; the Grand Duke was merely a man of military stratagem—when Yin lost virtue and feudal lords returned to Zhou, he aided the mandate.

sentences.zh: 祀典不云乎，『法施於人則祀之』？

translations.literal: Does the sacrifice canon not say, 'Sacrifice to those whose method was applied to the people'?
translations.idiomatic: Does the canon not say, 'Sacrifice to those whose method was applied to the people'?

sentences.zh: 如仲尼祖述堯舜，憲章文武，刪詩書，定禮樂，使君君、臣臣、父父、子子皆宗之，法施於人矣。

translations.literal: As Zhong Ni traced Yao and Shun, took Wen and Wu as models, edited the Odes and Documents, fixed rites and music, and made lord and minister, father and son all take him as ancestor—his method was applied to the people.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Ni traced Yao and Shun, took Wen and Wu as models, edited the Odes and Documents, fixed rites and music, and made lord and minister, father and son take him as ancestor—his method was applied to the people.

sentences.zh: 貞觀中，以太公兵家者流，始令磻溪立廟。

translations.literal: In Zhenguan, because the Grand Duke was of the military school, a temple was first ordered at Panxi.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenguan, because the Grand Duke was of the military school, a temple was first ordered at Panxi.

sentences.zh: 開元漸著上戊釋奠禮，其進不薄矣。

translations.literal: In Kaiyuan the upper-wu libation ritual gradually took form; the advance was not slight.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaiyuan the upper-wu libation ritual gradually took form; the advance was not slight.

sentences.zh: 上元之際，執事者苟意於兵，遂封王爵，號擬文宣，彼於聖人非倫也。

translations.literal: At Shangyuan, officers casually favored the military and so enfeoffed a king's title, with a title rivaling the Cultured Propagation King—he is not of a kind with sages.
translations.idiomatic: At Shangyuan, officers favored the military and enfeoffed a king's title rivaling the Cultured Propagation King—he is not of a kind with sages.

sentences.zh: 謂宜去武成王號，復為太公廟，奠享之制如紓請。

translations.literal: We say the Martial Completion King title should be removed, restored to the Grand Duke temple, with feast regulations as Shu requested.
translations.idiomatic: We say the Martial Completion King title should be removed, restored to the Grand Duke temple, with feast regulations as Shu requested.

sentences.zh: 」刑部員外郎陸淳等議曰：「武成王，殷臣也，紂暴不諫，而佐周傾之。

translations.literal: " Vice Director of Justice Lu Chun and others debated: "Martial Completion King was a Yin subject; Zhou was violent and he did not remonstrate, yet he assisted Zhou to overthrow it.
translations.idiomatic: " Vice Director of Justice Lu Chun and others debated: "Martial Completion King was a Yin subject; Zhou was violent and he did not remonstrate, yet he assisted Zhou to overthrow it.

sentences.zh: 夫尊道者師其人，使天下之人入是廟，登是堂，稽其人，思其道，則立節死義之士安所奮乎？

translations.literal: To honor the Way is to take its person as teacher; if all under heaven enter this temple, ascend this hall, examine this person and ponder this Way, where will those who establish integrity and die for righteousness be roused?
translations.idiomatic: To honor the Way is to take its person as teacher; if all under heaven enter this temple and ponder this person and Way, where will those who establish integrity and die for righteousness be roused?

sentences.zh: 聖人宗堯、舜，賢夷、齊，不法桓、文，不贊伊尹，殆謂此也。

translations.literal: Sages honor Yao and Shun, esteem Yi and Qi, do not take Huan and Wen as models, do not praise Yi Yin—probably meaning this.
translations.idiomatic: Sages honor Yao and Shun, esteem Yi and Qi, do not take Huan and Wen as models, do not praise Yi Yin—probably meaning this.

sentences.zh: 武成之名，與文宣偶，非不刊之典也。

translations.literal: The name Martial Completion paired with Cultured Propagation is not an unalterable canon.
translations.idiomatic: The name Martial Completion paired with Cultured Propagation is not an unalterable canon.

sentences.zh: 臣愚謂罷上元追封立廟，復磻溪祠，有司以時享，斯得矣。

translations.literal: Your servant humbly proposes abolishing the Shangyuan posthumous enfeoffment and temple establishment, restoring the Panxi shrine, with the relevant offices offering at the proper seasons—this would be fitting.
translations.idiomatic: We humbly propose abolishing the Shangyuan posthumous enfeoffment and temple, restoring the Panxi shrine, with officers offering at the proper seasons—this would be fitting.

sentences.zh: 」左領軍大將軍令狐建等二十四人議曰：「兵革未靖，宜右武以起忠烈。

translations.literal: " Left Army General Linghu Jian and twenty-four others debated: "Arms are not yet stilled; the military should be favored to rouse loyal fierceness.
translations.idiomatic: " Left Army General Linghu Jian and twenty-four others debated: "Arms are not yet stilled; the military should be favored to rouse loyal fierceness.

sentences.zh: 今特貶損，非勸也。

translations.literal: Now to demote specially is not encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: Now to demote specially is not encouragement.

sentences.zh: 且追王爵，以時祠，為武教主，文、武並宗，典禮已久，改之非也。

translations.literal: Moreover posthumous kingly title with timely sacrifice as martial cult-master, with civil and martial both honored—the ritual canon is long established; to change it would be wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover posthumous kingly title with timely sacrifice as martial cult-master, with civil and martial both honored—the ritual canon is long established; to change it would be wrong.

sentences.zh: 」乃詔以將軍為獻官，餘用紓奏。

translations.literal: " Then an edict made the general the offering officer; the rest followed Shu's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict made the general the offering officer; the rest followed Shu's memorial.

sentences.zh: 自是，以上將軍、大將軍、將軍為三獻。

translations.literal: From then on the Upper General, Grand General, and General were the three offerings.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the Upper General, Grand General, and General were the three offerings.

sentences.zh: 其五岳、四鎮，歲一祭，各以五郊迎氣日祭之。

translations.literal: The Five Sacred Peaks and Four Guardians were sacrificed to once a year, each on the day the five suburbs welcomed the season's qi.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Sacred Peaks and Four Guardians were sacrificed to once a year, each on the day the five suburbs welcomed the season's qi.

sentences.zh: 東岳岱山於兗州，東鎮沂山於沂州，南岳衡山於衡州，南鎮會稽於越州，中岳嵩高於河南，西岳華山於華州，西鎮吳山於隴州，北岳常山於定州，北鎮醫無閭於營州，東海於萊州，淮於唐州，南海於廣州，江於益州，西海及河於同州，北海及濟於河南。

translations.literal: Eastern Peak Mount Dai in Yanzhou, Eastern Guardian Mount Yi in Yizhou, Southern Peak Mount Heng in Hengzhou, Southern Guardian Kuaiji in Yuezhou, Central Peak Songgao in Henan, Western Peak Mount Hua in Huazhou, Western Guardian Mount Wu in Longzhou, Northern Peak Mount Chang in Dingzhou, Northern Guardian Yiwulü in Yingzhou, Eastern Sea in Laizhou, Huai in Tangzhou, Southern Sea in Guangzhou, Yangtze in Yizhou, Western Sea and Yellow River in Tongzhou, Northern Sea and Ji in Henan.
